label: d1_rtxpro6000_prefill_diag
note: Where does prefill time go, and does chunk size move it? Same model/flags as s1_rtxpro6000_nvfp4_fi. Server 1 (max-num-batched-tokens 8192, torch profiler on): profile 4 concurrent 10K-token prefills -> GPU kernel time by GEMM / attention / other; then OpenRelay's prefill probe. Servers 2-3: the probe at max-num-batched-tokens 16384 and 32768 (engine restart on the same box, weights kept).
